meta_description: J & T Service Center, Inc. serving Plymouth - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of towing in Plymouth.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
explore_h2: Stuck, stranded, or off the road
quote_h2: Tell us what you need done
footer_blurb: J & T Service Center, Inc. serving Plymouth.
about_h2: About J & T Service Center, Inc.
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Plymouth and the towns around it.
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.evidence: Red flatbed tow truck hauling an antique farm tractor across an open grass field.

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Red flatbed tow truck hauling a gray pickup truck down a gravel driveway lined with trees.

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Close-up of a maroon and white Chaparral boat loaded on its trailer for transport.

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Tow truck with blue emergency lights running beside a parked ambulance on a dark roadway a

White and orange wrecker truck displaying the company address and phone number parked near trees.

reviews.author: Bev Mullins
reviews.text: J & T Tire literally saved the day when I blew a tire 5 hours away from home. Not only did he pick us up and tow us the 45 minutes to his shop, he also drove an hour away to pick up the right size tire for my vehicle to get us back on the road! Excellent service!

reviews.author: Brian Bell
reviews.text: Twan went way above and beyond to take care of me in a tough situation. My alternator died over the weekend while visiting the area 2.5 hours from home. He showed up at my location and despite it being an import vehicle with hard to find parts, he tapped into multiple of his connections and resources to get the correct parts, to the right place, in the fastest time, and got everything completely fixed. Throughout the project he maintained an amazing positive attitude, communicated constantly, and came through on everything he said he would do to get it done. I highly recommend Twan and J & T Service Center. Thank you, Twan!

reviews.author: Samantha Ward
reviews.text: Back up and running because God sprinkles good people everywhere. Fast service for a new tire and very affordable.

reviews.author: James Shupe
reviews.text: The word "crook" fits perfectly for the owner of this towing company. My vehicle was towed less than five miles and he charged me $890.00. He would not allow me access to my vehicle without paying CASH. He then did not want to provide me with a bill or a receipt. He said that he would email them to me. Quite naturally I would no leave without a receipt so he had someone bring back a booklet of generic receipts. He never emailed me my copy of his outrageous bill.

reviews.author: Allyson McNiff
reviews.text: J & T saved our vacation!!! Very prompt, so professional! I cannot believe what a wonderful service we received. We would have missed our entire Thanksgiving had it not been for J & T! I cannot speak highly enough. We made our ferry to Ocracoke and so very thankful for good people!

reviews.author: Retfird
reviews.text: I had an issue with my trailer hitch while on the way home from the outer banks. I found J&T on my phone as a local shop. He immediately addressed my issue and got me safely back on the road. Wonderful guy and wonderful service. If you need help this is your shop. Thank you very much for your help today.

reviews.author: Scott Brechbiel
reviews.text: Called J&T for wrecker service since my truck overheated coming back from the outer banks. They were quick to respond, let me know they could also repair if I wanted them to. They performed the repairs, keeping me well informed of what they were finding. They did a great job with thw repairs. I highly recommend them for wrecker service and car repairs. Great folks!!

reviews.author: Lynn Snow
reviews.text: Amazing. We were having trouble on the way to the beach when we came across this shop. They had been closed for an hour but still there. He graciously hooked us up to the scanner and worked on our vehicle. He also offered valuable advice for the future. Wonderful customer service that is not easily found these days.

reviews.author: Jessica Newbold
reviews.text: Twan found us sitting with a flat tire on our camper waiting for Good Sam dispatch to arrive. Twan was a heaven send! He quoted us $300 less than Good Sam & had us back on the road within 30 minutes! He even let us keep one of the two flat tires that just needed a new valve! Great customer service, super nice guy, I definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Ashley Franckewitz
reviews.text: On our way home on a Saturday from our beach trip to Cape Hatteras and had a camper tire blow out. We found J&T Service Center which was literally on the road home from the beach. The guys changed all of our camper tires and had us back on the road in less than an hour. Very reasonably priced and friendly too. We’ve decided from now on every 3 years we will just plan to stop here and get all of the camper tires replaced on the way to the beach. I absolutely would recommend J&T Service Center if you’re anywhere near them! Thank you guys so much for the awesome quick service!

reviews.author: Vanessa Torres
reviews.text: Our van started shaking while we were 5 hours away from home. J and T overcharged us on the parts and labor, asking us to pay double the price for everything, and the car wasnt even driveable after. It was actually shaking worse! At the beginning, they mentioned the price of $600, but AFTER they completed the work they said it would be $1,250! I was shocked. I felt taken advantage of in a vulnerable situation. Our car sat for hours unworked on as they gathered the parts, (I know this bc i had to go get things from the car over the course of several hours and saw no one working on it) and then charged us $690 for labor for less than one hour of actual work! Our van wasn't operable after they "fixed" it and we had to purchase a new van in order to get home! Over 1,250 wasted today at J and T service center.

reviews.author: Chasidy Jethro
reviews.text: My tire had an air leak and colony tire didn't have any openings. J&T had my tire in stock and replaced it in about 20 minutes. I was impressed. They were very helpful knowledgeable and dependable. I highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Shantel Russell
reviews.text: I was visiting Plymouth and my car broke down. J&T responded quickly to tow my car to the shop. Within minutes I had a diagnostic done and the owner was finding the parts to complete the job. He was able to replace my fuel pump the next working day and get me back on the road. I am happy about the services received and my vehicle is running great!

reviews.author: Dana McCray
reviews.text: We were stuck in the mud on our way to the airport. The tow company answered right away when I called and arrived within an hour, being 30 miles away from us. A very nice gentleman got us hooked up, pulled out, and back on the road within 10 minutes of getting to us. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Michelle Taylor
reviews.text: I highly recommend J & T Service. This afternoon my tire low light came on. There aren’t many places available on a Saturday at 4:00. I called as I was traveling to Hatteras because it’s pretty sparse on car help after this point. The owner told me to come on in, he was closing but would wait for me. They checked my tires and they were not off by much but the light didn’t go off. He ran a diagnostic and said I had a sensor problem. They were so nice and helpful and we talked about doing the right thing for people. They absolutely are someone who do the right thing. Good and honest people.

reviews.author: Casey George
reviews.text: We were out of town and broke down (alternator died) on the way to a sporting event. This was the top rated tow company on Google so we have them a call. They were there within about 20 minutes, including with my bad directions since we didn't know where we were. He offered to tow us to our regular mechanic about 30 miles away, or said he could tow it to his shop and get it repaired that day, on a Saturday nonetheless. We let him tow it to his place as I knew it's be at least 3 days before or mechanic could look at it since he doesn't do weekends. Service was fast, price was fair based on what I saw online, and he was incredibly kind. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sarah Benton
reviews.text: We were coming home from the Outer Banks and had a tire blow on our heavy duty truck. It was right at the end of their workday, but they were able to get us taken care of and back on the road in no time. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Anthony Walker
reviews.text: Had a abosolute fantastic experience with J&T. I called early morning due to a break down after an exhausting experience with AAA, I was able to get back to Plymouth with my Wife and Vehicle. He had me call first thing in the morning and came to our hotel and picked up my vehicle and worked on it effectively and knowledgeably. I was able to get my car fixed and get back home safely thanks to him. I highly recommend him and his team for services. Thank you again J&T

reviews.author: Zachary Singletary
reviews.text: Twice now J&T Service Center has gone above and beyond to help my mom (Mary Ellen) with her car troubles and made sure she was well-informed and safe. Twan helped her get to work when she had issues getting her car started, and then when the problem happened again a week or so later made a house call to diagnose her problem and got the car serviced. The prices were more than fair and the people (especially Twan) were wonderful. You should absolutely support this place!!!

reviews.author: Danielle Connerton
reviews.text: We were heading to Nags Head Saturday morning and our tire went flat on the highway. We called J&T Service Center & Towing and he was there within 10 minutes ready to help! He had our tire fixed and we were back on the road within 10 minutes. He is a honest, & reliable person that I trust to call on whenever I am broken down or have a flat and need help quickly! Their prices won’t break your bank either which helps a lot! A++++ service

reviews.author: Lora Snider
reviews.text: Had a low tire pressure light come on traveling to the OBX and knew there would be limited help available on a weekend, after hours, and few resources available. Searched on Google and this popped up. WOW and AMAZING service. Good honest people still exist. They told us to come as they were getting ready to close but would wait on us. They checked everything and made sure we were safe to keep traveling. Both the man and the woman who helped us were kind and we cannot say thank you enough. Do NOT hesitate to call them or to stop by (right beside Subway) and send them your business. I hope they continue to thrive and succeed. We need more people like this in the world.

reviews.author: Brenna Martin
reviews.text: THANK YOU! I had just started my six hour drive home when my brakes went out. I ended up here by chance and it was definitely the best case scenario! I showed up unannounced and the owner (I’m assuming) took a look and immediately knew what was wrong. he was very informative and comforting to me as a young woman who feels a bit out of place at a mechanic. he spoke with my dad on the phone to explain what happened, fixed my brakes in less than 20 minutes, and charged a very reasonable fee! he has a wonderful family and they were all very friendly. definitely recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Lily DiGennaro
reviews.text: Husband and I were driving from Outerbanks to Georgia on our way back from a family reunion. Our battery light came on an hour into the drive and battery quickly started draining. Lucky we were able to make it to Twan’s place and he absolutely took care of us. He quickly identified the issue and replaced the parts. We were on the road again in about 4 hours. (Dealership said they wouldn’t be able to do the repair until at least three days out!!!!!) Big thanks to Twan and his team for their excellent service and we highly recommend J&T auto.

reviews.author: Tim George
reviews.text: Twan came to our rescue on a Sunday afternoon when every tire repair shop around was closed. We blew a trailer tire while pulling our boat back from the coast and were stuck on the side of the road 2 hours away from home. He was prompt, courteous and very reasonable. He showed up quickly, took the tire and rim back to his shop and returned with a new tire mounted on our rim. Got us back on the road in no time! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Bruce Maggs
reviews.text: These guys rescued me! I stopped for gas in the evening in Plymouth and as I pulled away from the gas station I discovered that one of my brakes had seized up. Because of the hour I was worried that I was going to be stranded. But J & T came and towed me to their shop within 20 minutes of my call, tracked down the needed replacement part, and fixed the problem. Thanks again!

reviews.author: James Collins
reviews.text: I highly recommend this business! I can’t say enough positive things. I was working on a family project with my dad and managed to get a Bobcat (Heavy Equipment) completely stuck. My father knew the best service provider in the area for this problem was J&T. He came by immediately and towed me out! He was extremely professional and courteous. Somehow I had also damaged two of the tires. I purchased the tires and J&T mounted them the same afternoon. Now I’m sure someone thinks this is just average. I failed to mention that all of this happened on the Saturday before Memorial Day when practically every other business was closed.

reviews.author: Anna Tramble
reviews.text: Amazing service and people! We were traveling through Plymouth to go to the outer banks and blew a tire on our travel trailer. J&T had a tire for a great price with super quick service. They also went above and beyond and replaced our spare tire. We are very thankful that they were open on the weekend and able to help us. I would highly recommend this place for any car service or tire needs!

reviews.author: Mallory VanHoy
reviews.text: Out of town and still a couple hours away from our destination when we ran into some tire/wheel trouble. Not only was he there in less than 30 minutes but he was able to fix it and we got back on the road in no time. So appreciative and highly recommend!!! If you need a tow or auto repair give him a call!

reviews.author: Jensen LeJeune
reviews.text: I was in the process of moving from NC to Florida when my car broke down early in the morning. As a 25 year old female stranded on the side of the road, no idea where I was at, and the closest family I had was 8 hours away, I was terrified. The towing company took me to J & T and I had the BEST experience ever. They made me feel so safe & comfortable, explained everything that was wrong with my car, and had me fixed up and back on the road in just over an hour! Everyone was so friendly and they didn't try to up-charge me or do any unnecessary work, which is easy to do to a girl who has no idea about cars. I can't thank them enough for all of their help & would HIGHLY recommend to anyone needing work in the Plymouth, NC area.

reviews.author: Catherine Harper
reviews.text: Ran into car troubles passing through Plymouth while traveling. Luckily we were a short distance from J&Ts and they got us right in with no wait. They were able to replace the radiator in a pinch and even got a new radiator delivered within 30 minutes. The staff is so helpful and friendly. The lobby / office area is clean and there is plenty of space to sit. J&Ts really saved us!!

reviews.author: alexandria drew
reviews.text: Got a flat tire on the way to the beach. I ended up being towed to J and T to get my tire replaced. Everyone was professional and personable. They explained to me the process and the choices in tires. I was quite impressed. I was able to get my tire at a lower cost than the dealership!! They even threw in a car wash!! I would recommend them to anyone in this area.

reviews.author: Annie Sheffield
reviews.text: J & T is simply amazing! I had a car problem at an inconvenient time and location where AAA could not provide any service. Twan promptly responded to my call for help and came to my aid without even needing to tow my vehicle. With his skills and expertise, he was able to quickly diagnose and fix the issue! I am extremely grateful for his exceptional service and I highly recommend him to anyone in need of assistance with their vehicle. Thank you, J&T!

reviews.author: Caitlin Peterson
reviews.text: My husband and I were on our way to Chapel Hill, NC from Outer Banks/Kitty Hawk; our ultimate destination that day was Asheville, NC; we're from Little Rock, AR. We got a flat mid route and we were stranded otherwise. T&J's was the only place open that day. The owner told us "I'll get you home." and that's exactly what he did. He was timely, professional, and did everything well. His staff was friendly also. I would highly recommend him and his team! Thanks so much for getting us home!!

reviews.author: Aisha Nieves
reviews.text: J&T came through when AAA didn't. He was extremely helpful and professional. Came out to us ASAP. Didn't need to wait 4 hours like we did with AAA. Couldn't have asked for anyone better. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Katlyn Perkins
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful service. Our tire popped at 8pm on a weekend and they were able to get 4 new tires and have the car ready to go by 10am the next morning. Quick, efficient, and friendly staff that is readily available and willing to help out. We would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jason Strickland
reviews.text: Twan and Mel were top notch last week when I had a tire blowout 2 hrs from home. They stayed after hrs to meet me beside the road, remove my tire and replace it waits another one. I can honestly say they turned a stressful situation into a relaxed remedy. I HIGHLY recommend these guys for any vehicle service you may need. If they were any closer, I’d invite them to Sunday dinner!! Great customer service guys!! Thank you!

reviews.author: Tj Wasser
reviews.text: Knowledgeable and excellent service at a reasonable price. Driving back home from Outer Banks our car was wobbling, they fit us in right away and found the issue. They didn't have what we needed in stock but took the time to find where we could go safely on our route to get it fixed.

reviews.author: A Lewis
reviews.text: For starters customer service was amazing!!! I have relied on J&T Service Center on several different incidents. I had a friend who had locked her keys in the trunk. Within 15 minutes of my call J&T arrived and resolved the problem. What I appreciate most about this company is the response time, the reasonable prices, and the people skills. I would recommend this company to anyone in need.

reviews.author: Nancy Dahl
reviews.text: The owner, Twan, came to our aide after fuel pump went out 120 miles from home. Even with the confusion working with Roadside Assistance, he was polite and comforting. He delivered not only our car home safely but my husband and me as well. I highly recommend that if you are in a similar unfortunate circumstance in Eastern North Carolina, you contact J&T Auto Repair in Plymouth.

reviews.author: Johanna Beasley
reviews.text: J & T Service Center saved our day! We were traveling from the Outer Banks to Raleigh when the front bearing assembly went out. J & T Service Center took us immediately, and had us back up and on the road in no time at all. They were extremely nice and accommodating we are very appreciative of their services. Thank you Twan!

reviews.author: Jocelyn Hiatt
reviews.text: We got a flat on the way to the outer banks on Sunday, on Father's day. We are from Indiana and had no idea what to do. Everywhere I called was closed. Luckily we were directed to J & T's and We are so grateful. Not only did he get our tire off without having our wheel lock (2 other mechanics had tried previous to our trip and had been unable to.) He got to us quickly and back on the road for our family vacation. I couldn't recommend them more!!

reviews.author: William Ziegler
reviews.text: Had a vehicle issue ony way to work that resulted in me being stuck along the road early in the morning. Called and was told "I'll be right there", I was relieved when the truck pulled up in what seemed almost immediately (although I was at least 30mins from Plymouth). When he arrived, he took his time to analyze the situation (my tire fell off while driving) and my vehicle to make sure he hooked onto it without damaging my vehicle. Towed back to their service center and had it repaired by lunch. Professional, responsive, and courteous. Already have their number in my phone if I need to call again! Thank you gentlemen for being there!

reviews.author: djbowen87
reviews.text: Wife already left a review but I also wanted to. Driving home from Vacation today I had a horrible vibration in our van and found I had a tire coming apart. They got me a tire and mounted and balanced in no time and had us on our way! Everyone was so friendly and helpful, couldn’t have asked for a better experience in a stressful situation. Highly recommend! 5 stars! Thank y’all so much!

reviews.author: Joseph Snead
reviews.text: I am not one to lots of reviews, but when I get great service, I feel I have to make the time, because these days, it's hard to find. I got excellent customer service from J&T Service Center this past Friday night as I was travelling through Plymouth. My truck had something break, and it couldn't be driven any more. My hopes were that it could be towed back to Greenville that night. Twan was a little unsure if he could get it to Greenville that night versus the following day due to his work load. I am not actually sure what plans he may have had that night with his family or friends, if any, but he went above and beyond and towed it to where I needed it, which made my weekend more enjoyable not having to worry. That is how you handle business, and why I believe it's important to support small business owners like J&T Service Center.

reviews.author: Kelly Jamieson
reviews.text: I am incredibly grateful for J & T Service Center! While traveling through Plymouth one evening, I got a horribly flat tire that left me stranded on the side of US-64. Without Twan's help, I would have been waiting hours for a tow from AAA. Twan was extremely generous with his time and replaced my tire quickly so that I could get back on the road. I highly recommend J & T Service Center, Inc. for all of your service needs!

reviews.author: Edward Gonzalez
reviews.text: I can't tell anybody not to take There vehicles here for service or repairs. But I can't say. I will never, ever take my vehicles back there and I will. Not refer them to anyone and if anybody I know is thinking about taking their vehicles there. I will tell them the experience I had. The owner Of the shop is very rude. They had my truck for 3 weeks. They put a $15 part in my truck and it still had the same problem then they said they had to order a part and it was back order. They replaced the wrong sensor. I had no problem finding the right sensor for that truck. Like I said, I will never let them touch my vehicles again. And I will never refer them to anyone. And by the way, they still charge me a $110. Before they released my truck back to me while it was still broke.

reviews.author: H Hoffhines
reviews.text: The owner came through when my husband and I were in a pinch. Even though it was a Saturday, he helped us out as fast as he could. He was professional and communicative through the whole process. Would definitely recommend this company to others in need of a tow or roadside assistance.

reviews.author: Holly Fales
reviews.text: Super nice people and fast service!! We were in desperate need of brake repair when we had an issue while pulling our camper. Nobody else was able to complete the fix on a Friday afternoon, but J&T was able to fix on the spot and saved our beach vacation. Very fair on price, highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Lisa Nelson
reviews.text: We had mechanical issue and had to be towed. Our driver was very nice and accommodating, especially considering there were 2 of us and a cat. He went above and beyond by stopping at the car rental place that was about to close! Thanks so much! We really appreciate your kindness.

reviews.author: Earl&Beth Witman
reviews.text: My disabled veteran husband blew a tire and ended up in a ditch outside of Plymouth. They dropped everything, ran right to him and towed the truck out, and replaced the tire. Extremely impressed, fair pricing (especially for a Saturday emergency!!) And very professional services. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Aly Inez
reviews.text: J & T to the RESCUE! I can't even begin to say how much we appreciate this business. We were stranded about 2 hours from home when my mom dropped her car keys in the water while we were sightseeing out of state. We were stranded... of course in the evening on a weekend and had no clue what we were going to do. No place would help us! And then we found these guys on Google and not only did he say he could help us, but he arrived fast and got us all home safe. He went way out of his way to help us and we couldn't be more grateful! Thank you so much for getting us home! Would definitely recommend to anyone in need of help!

reviews.author: Andy Welborn
reviews.text: We had two blowouts on Sunday with some heavy duty tires (225 70 19.5). We got a hold of J&T and brought rims and tires in. Swapped them out. Lifesaver to be able to get someone on Sunday with us being 400 miles from home.

reviews.author: Kim Whitehurst
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!! J&T saved my husband and I close to 500$! Our appointment was for a Thursday and our plans changed and they got us in the day before. Also while there they inspected my husband's truck, last minute! We 're looking forward to being life time costumers! THANKS J&T!!!

reviews.author: Suzanne McLemore
reviews.text: We were stranded at 5:30 on on our way to Manteo. My roadside assistance dropped my call 4 times. When we searched for someone on our own , of all the businesses available, J & T were the only ones to answer the phone Helpful and friendly Exactly what I needed with my grandson and disabled daughter in the car. . Thank you for being a kind and thoughtful business. Great job

reviews.author: Brad Terry
reviews.text: We had a tire blow out on our brand new Airstream a few months back and called road side assistance. J&T was contracted by our road side assistance company. J&T reps arrived, and with out assessing the frame and proper location for the jack, and lifted the trailer directly under the freshwater tank, crushing it and ruining the valve. We filed a claim, and J&T ignored us. We have been forced to file a $4000 claim to have a new tank installed. The guys who arrived were sloppy at their job. I would be ok if they at least stepped up and handled our repairs through their insurance but no luck. Go elsewhere. I would not recommend this company for their services.

reviews.author: Bambi Bengsch
reviews.text: The owner is compassionate and genuinely caring! He made a horrible situation so much easier for my family! He said "I got you don't worry" In these times of covid we also needed to get home an hour and a half away... He is so awesome, professional and has a big heart! He has been in the business over 20 years! He spoke highly of his family as well. If you ever need a tow....Please call him!

reviews.author: Brenda Butler
reviews.text: J&T service came to the rescue on Sunday afternoon. We had a tire to blow out while on highway 64. We gave him a call and met him with the blow out and another one getting ready to blow out. He and his brother were lifesavers. Will highly recommend them. Thank you so very much for your help.

reviews.author: Laurie Slagle
reviews.text: Highly recommend. We were coming home from beach and ran over something in the road. We attempted to change the tire but it fell off the jack. Called them and he came out immediately. We was back on the road in minutes and he got us to even stop at his shop so he could check the tire. Great service, fair price, and friendly.

reviews.author: Moses A Boyce
reviews.text: I have never seeing a man like this young man, he doesn’t only treat you like a customer but like a friend and family, he goes way beyond and above of servicing your car, and service your needs as a customer when you at his garage. He’s one in a million, I pray God’s continue blessing and favors upon his life and his family.

reviews.author: Jami Brown
reviews.text: My son and his dog are traveling home for the summer from Wilmington and get a flat in Roper. I googled nearest place and found J & T and called. Twan was so professional, nice, and calming to this frantic momma. He was to my son within 10 minutes of the call and got him back on the road again. Twan’s wife was super nice and professional as well taking my payment over the phone. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing services! Knowing caring and nice people like this are around to help makes this momma very happy!! 5+stars for sure!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Alex Alvarez
reviews.text: If I could give this company a 10/10 I would. AMAZING service! VERY professional! My car died on a Sunday driving through creswell and within 20 mins they were there to pick up my car and take it back to the shop in Plymouth. I was at a loss because I didn’t know what happened and Twan hooked my car up to a diagnostic reader and helped me figure out what was going on. Twan went above and beyond what any other tow truck driver/mechanic would do. He was clear and up front about the problems my car was experiencing and had fair prices on towing. If ever my car would need a tow again these guys are the first I’d call!

reviews.author: Kelly Roberts
reviews.text: These two brothers are the best! My mother in law blew a tire and they stayed open till we arrived to help us with a new tire. Thank you so much has! I may just drive from Manteo to get new tires from J&T when I need them!

reviews.author: Jim White
reviews.text: Great towing company! My 1999 Yukon broke down on the way back home to Raleigh after a great week on the outer banks. Had the whole family with me and it was a late afternoon on a Saturday and all businesses closed in the small town of Roper NC. Twan Ruffin came to the rescue and towed the Yukon and whole family to Raleigh. Not only that he has a great attitude and wonderful out look on life. I would highly recommend him and his team. Great company and wonderful person!

reviews.author: W BR
reviews.text: Best tire service I have ever experienced, price was reasonable and they were quick at solving my tire issue on our RV. They were closed, yet stayed open to help us!

reviews.author: Ellen White
reviews.text: In a word - AMAZING! We were stranded in Roper on our way back from our beach vacation with the family and they came trough with shining colors!! Not only did they not hesitate to haul us back to Raleigh (4 hours round trip), but knew exactly what was wrong with our truck. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: john macon
reviews.text: Pleasant and efficient auto repair shop. I found them on google and recommend anyone who needs auto repairs that are in the area to go there. l came all the way from NJ and was completely satisfied and priced reasonable. Thank you for your service.

reviews.author: Levi Wheeler
reviews.text: So mu good friend blew a tire and these guys came ans jumped their car and then changed their tire at 830 AM . They were quick and professional. Also very friendly. Not to expensive as well. Altogether a great service.

reviews.author: Hodges Myers
reviews.text: My daughter called me in tears because her car would not start after she fueled up at a gas station near Plymouth, North Carolina. Twan came highly recommended by another automotive repair place who did not have anyone mobile. He arrived just a few minutes after my call, and just a few minutes later my daughter was on her way with the knowledge of what has gone wrong, and a plan to DREX a permanent fix. Prompt, professional, kind, honest. 10 out of 10. Would recommend. Thank you Twan!

reviews.author: William Downing
reviews.text: Phenomenal service I was transporting a car from Greensboro back to Plymouth my alternator and battery fail on my truck. So I called J&T service center and in 2 1/2 hrs they where in Raleigh in 440 installing the parts on my truck, so I would highly recommend and or advise anyone to patronize J&T service center

reviews.author: Winston Hawkins
reviews.text: Twan is the man, he took car of my son who broke down out side Plymouth. The previous shop did not tighten the bolts on wheels and brake calipers after the recent brake job. I called the larger tire company in town and was referred to J & T from a competitor. I called him at 4;15 pm on a Friday and he was on site by 5:00, repair done by 6:00 and the boys were back on the road. He is a stand up guy and does great work. Thank you for taking care of my family

reviews.author: Max Stabley
reviews.text: My car engine had started to smoke a lot when I was traveling back home, leading me to have to leave my car on the side of the road near basically nothing. Twan made sure to get my car off the highway and towed it to a safe place in fast time. Very professional and quick service that went above and beyond my expectations.

reviews.author: Sarah Blount
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about these guys. They were truly my lifesaver after I hit a pothole and tore both rims and tires on that side up. They deserve more than 5 stars!! They turned a bad experience into a good one and are just the Finest Kind of folks. Above and beyond!!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Madigan
reviews.text: J & T made a stressful morning much more manageable after my car died at 5 am on the way to work. I greatly appreciated their prompt and friendly service as well as their quick work fixing the problem and getting my car back to me.

reviews.author: Hamdiya Moore
reviews.text: Whenever I’m having an issue with my car or truck, it is only one place I will go for my car care experience. Just yesterday my truck had broke down way in Bertie County in the middle of nowhere late in the evening .. lol And I called Twan and he said what’s wrong and I’m coming right now. He was there in least then 30 minutes, towed my truck to his shop and was fixed the next morning. He has always given me and my mom an awesome experience, I trust no one but Twan when it comes to my car care experience.

reviews.author: Alex Best
reviews.text: We were traveling down the east coast and ended up with a slow leak. The guys at J&T got us in right away and plugged the leaks quick. Amazing customer service and polite gentlemen. If you’re in the area and need any work done they are the guys to see.

reviews.author: Glenda Kramer
reviews.text: Had a flat tire on our RV on a Saturday morning. J&T was the only place open - they took us in right away and had us back on the road in 30 min! Very friendly, knowledgeable and fair prices!

reviews.author: Karissa Myers
reviews.text: If I could leave a 0 star review I would. IF YOU EVER GET YOUR OIL CHANGED HERE MAKE SURE YOU CHECK WHEN THEY SAY THEY ARE DONE. Just took my truck here to have an oil change, the man came out way too soon saying it was done. So, as I always do, I checked once I got back to my job site. Sure enough the oil, and oil filter had NOT been changed. I went back immediately, and asked for a refund. Thankfully, my money was returned and the law didn’t have to get involved.

reviews.author: Courtney Mccall
reviews.text: These guys saved us a ton of money AND our vacation!!! They are AMAZING!! Would definitely recommend to anyone!! What would have been three days they did in one. Thank you J & T!! We we're blessed!!!

reviews.author: James Wojcik
reviews.text: Knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. Oil change took only 10 minutes or so after being lifted. Good business.

reviews.author: Kendra Downing
reviews.text: My aunt was locked out of her car this morning, I called them for her & they were there in less than 30 minutes. He was fast, friendly & affordable. I'm pleased

reviews.author: Brandon Long
reviews.text: I just wanted to give a major shout out to this company! I was a on a fishing trip with a friend and had a bearing explode on my boat trailer. We were staying in Columbia and I called service man Tawaan came right out assessed the repair and was on the spot! I definitely will use them again if need be! The best all around experience made a bad situation aliitle more tolerable with their help! THANKS AGAIN!!

reviews.author: B.O.B. BeautyOnaBudget
reviews.text: I ordered new tires for my car. They had them r ady and got me in and out fast. We went to subway next door while the tires were getting changed by the time we came out we was ready to go. Very friendly professional environment

reviews.author: R William Perry
reviews.text: J & T Service was able to scedule me in for an oil change when I needed it RIGHT NOW. They were able to do so despite a lot going on. I got in and out even more quickly than I hoped and saved my day. Their service knocked my socks off! Thanks, J & T.

reviews.author: keely munoz
reviews.text: The guys had just closed the shop on Saturday afternoon. We pulled up with the spare tire on the car 2 1/2 hours away from home. They opened back up and got us taken care of in no time. Amazing service and they didn’t even seem angry we came after they closed. They were awesome.

reviews.author: Ashley Wilkins
reviews.text: Great people and awesome service. Very seldom you can get both of these in one place. I have had several repairs such as a/c compressor, brakes, tire plug, and purchased tires. If you're in a rush no problem they will have you fixed and ready to go in no time.

reviews.author: Tomeeka Hines
reviews.text: Call them today my car towed from Plymouth to Edenton and he(Twan) was right on it. Very professional. Will call them again. They replaced my brakes on my car front and back a few weeks ago. Great service!!

reviews.author: Lesa Hardison
reviews.text: Twan went above and beyond in helping me out of a jam when my battery died on my month old truck. He was on time and did absolutely everything in his power to help. Highly professional and extremely personable. Would highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: Pj Bunch
reviews.text: Words cannot describe the joy I felt seeing that truck coming from the horizon. They got me out of a tight jam and helped me get back. The hope is to not need a tow truck again, but in the unfortunate event of needing one in the Roper, Plymouth area J & T should be the go to.

reviews.author: Brandy c
reviews.text: J&T are Amazing.... I was so glad to have such friendly and professional folks to work on my vehicle! After my accident they fixed and detailed my vehicle, and it looks better than the day I purchased it brand new... Thank y'all!

reviews.author: Timothy McAuliffe
reviews.text: Just wanted to give a big thanks to Twan at J & T for helping out a stranded stranger. He did everything he could to help and kept me updated as the process unfolded. And the end result is a good as new car for a reasonable price! Thanks again.

reviews.author: Emiliano Tapia
reviews.text: Car cut out of me on a trip and ended up stuck on the side of the road. Within 20 minutes was able to get me towed out of an awkward spot, took me to the shop, and had my car up and running in no time. Absolutely pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Howerton
reviews.text: Twan was fabulous. He arrived quickly and was courteous on the phone and in person. He replaced two tires for us and got us on our way to the beach in no time.

reviews.author: Brad Makepeace
reviews.text: Had a trailer tire blow out on 64, called him at 3:00 on a Saturday, he met us at the shop and swapped out the tire in 10mins! Great service!

reviews.author: Naila Mariam Ghori
reviews.text: Excellent service, we had a flat tire and had no other service station open. We were served on call. He came back after shop was closed to help us.

reviews.author: Shana Bowen
reviews.text: We were 5.5 hours from home with a bad tire on our Van. They ended up having one used one in our size and got us back on the road quickly! Thank y’all so much & God bless you and your family!

reviews.author: Sonja Littlejohn
reviews.text: Excellent service and very professional staff! I have been here several times for an oil change and tire repair and Twan is always accommodating. Thank you Twan for good quality work! Definitely stop by and check them out!

reviews.author: Tori
reviews.text: I definitely recommend J&T Services! My family and I were stranded in Roper NC coming home from vacation. J&T personally drove us home to Raleigh NC. Thank you so much for getting my family and I home safely!

reviews.author: John Casella
reviews.text: I called John for my son, who was stuck on the road 4 hours from home in Plymouth NC. John was immediately on the call and helped tow the car to his shop for diagnostics. I was so appreciative of his response and helping my son get back on the road! Thanks John!!

reviews.author: Heather Bee
reviews.text: I very much highly recommend this place! My car was broke down and they got me towed and got the problem fixed perfectly. They are by far the nicest and most honest people i’ve dealt with. Don’t hesitate to call them, very professional!!

reviews.author: Susan Adams
reviews.text: Flat tire on the way to the airport on a Saturday and they were so kind to open the shop and fix it. We were in and out in less than 15 minutes. Wonderful people!

reviews.author: Clarisha W
reviews.text: Very friendly and professional! I needed tires badly and had to go to work an hour away (was scared to take the drive with bad tires)! They didn’t have the tires that i needed at the location and went and got them from their warehouse! I didn’t even have an appointment and they were able to provide the service i needed right then and there! Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Jake Klink
reviews.text: Popped a flat headed to the beach, had me on the road 30 minutes after i called. Excellent work and friendly service

reviews.author: Hannah G Crow
reviews.text: This was one of the best service centers I’ve ever encountered. The team was PHENOMENAL and so helpful, quick, and response in my team of need. I can not say enough good things about this place, the owner, or my experience here. THANK YOU!!!!

reviews.author: John Van Swearingen
reviews.text: Incredible folks. They picked us up for a tow from Plymouth to Raleigh following a collision. Didn't matter that it was short notice; it ended up being a very easy experience.

reviews.author: Scott Swiatkowski
reviews.text: Called up there for a jump and someone came immediately, less than 2 minutes. Followed them back to the service center and had the battery tested and it turned out fine. Would recommend to anyone in the area.

reviews.author: Walter Hancock
reviews.text: Had a tire issue on the way to the OBX and was recommended to stop at J & T, great people! They were fast and very fair also had a nice lobby area to wait in. Thanks for the help!

reviews.author: Ethen Lund
reviews.text: They helped me out when I got a flat tire on the side of a rural highway. Quick, communicative, helpful. Even came by on a Sunday when most other services were closed. Friendly and supportive and offered helpful advice.

reviews.author: Colby Lipscomb
reviews.text: Got caught with some major trouble while passing through and they saved the day! Incredibly helpful and nice staff. Five star experience absolutely! Also a very nice facility while we waited.

reviews.author: Gracelyn Mirick
reviews.text: They helped me out!!! Had my low pressure light come on while traveling and they were happy to help... no wait!! Very courteous and professional! Got me straight and back on the road!! Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Matthew Swain
reviews.text: My wife had a blowout the day before. Rode in on a spare and they swapped all the tires out in a flash! Wonderful service and awesome people. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kendall Shackelford
reviews.text: Amazing service. Even stayed late to help us with a tire problem as we traveled to the beach. They went above and beyond to help with our needs, highly recommend!!

reviews.author: luke johnson
reviews.text: Helped me late at night when locked out of my Toyota Tundra. Arrived on time and charged a very fair price. Thank you!

reviews.author: Netnet Ruffin
reviews.text: Excellent company to work with, went above and beyond in aiding my family access to get out my belongings. Would recommend them to anyone needing their services.

reviews.author: Zakk Ogle
reviews.text: Went over the fourth of July weekend to get a tire for my car about the 6th one that I have had to place on my car here in Plymouth since 2020 only went here because it was the only place open got a used tire and not even a month later flat tire again upon checking it out I discovered the tire I had bought had been plugged sold me a plugged tire i understand you get what you paid for but 80 bucks for a used tire mount and balance then gimme a plugged tire man come on Please if the massive potholes in front of the building and prices does not throw you off let this review do so.

reviews.author: Baird Stokes
reviews.text: Very personable, his tow truck is the cleanest and best maintained Ive ever seen, its like new! If you ever need a tow this is the company I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Alec Norvell
reviews.text: Have great customer service, tire was very flat, I was driving down the rode and they pulled over to help. Very generous a mechanic who knows his job and gets it done

reviews.author: Diane Soucy
reviews.text: These guys went above and beyond to help us with our small travel trailer. They towed us and repaired our burned out part. Great family business and caring guys.

reviews.author: Luther Glover
reviews.text: I highly recommend J & T service center! Twan was very helpful and saved us a lot of money. Give them a call for quality and honest work!

reviews.author: Dejah Brown
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for years and each time I’ve been here they have always been professional and eager to help! Any problem you may have or any question you may have , they will help you in a honest and professional manner. I highly recommended to anyone .i will never go anywhere else to get my car serviced .

reviews.author: Franky mc
reviews.text: Hands down best in the area. These guys have helped get me out of a pinch, worked hard & went out of their way to get me going at a decent price.

reviews.author: Stephen Williams
reviews.text: A great source of help in a time of need. Surprisingly, they had what I needed to get me moving down the highway. When down on your luck give them a call to pick you back up.

reviews.author: Kathy Monterroso
reviews.text: LITERALLY THE BEST! i called to get a new tire since i got a flat tire and he came right away! i highly recommended him 100%

reviews.author: Dawn Treaster
reviews.text: A super nice gentleman came to our rescue when we were 5+ hours from home. He got us back and running. Thankyou so much.

reviews.author: J Purk
reviews.text: I was coming from Virginia and trailer tire blew in Elizabeth City, no spare tire, striped nuts and studs, J&T services came through in the clutch and went out and beyond their way to make sure I got what I needed to get my trailer back rolling.

reviews.author: Michael Lydick
reviews.text: Had the part I needed for my Xterra. Was stuck with a misfiring cylinder. Super friendly, nice, and fair pricing. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: T Joseph
reviews.text: Had a nail in my tire while in town. The guys here took care of it on a Saturday morning in 15 minutes. Well done.

reviews.author: Robert Hawk
reviews.text: Called after running out of fuel a couple miles from them and was told it would be at least 3 hours before they could arrive.

reviews.author: Justin Prince
reviews.text: Awesome owner. Helped us out late when we were stranded traveling through. Definitely give them a call.

reviews.author: Science And Stuff
reviews.text: Got us in and out so quickly. Staff so nice and kind. Definitely come here, especially if you’re in a hurry.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: Owner needs to learn how to address people, without having a attitude and shutting them down before they can explain what’s going on with vehicle.
